subject: Priv infra CI maintainability & evidence handoff
messages:
From: Dev Ops (ACME) <devops@acme.example.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: ACME Procurement <procure@acme.example.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Priv infra CI maintainability & handoff request

Marissa —

Thanks for taking the call earlier. As we finalize the private deployment SOW we need a compact handoff package of CI/IaC artifacts for our security and procurement teams to validate. Can you provide the following by EOD Tuesday (2025-09-15)?

- Per-module list (Terraform/Helm/Ansible) with owning team and last-modified date
- CI pipeline diff for the proposed merge (branch -> main) — only config changes
- A short runbook for how to re-run the policy checks locally (commands + expected outputs)
- Evidence CSV that maps module -> artifact hash -> signed-commit id (for our audit)

I attached a sample template (iac-evidence.csv) to show the columns we need. Procurement is copied for scheduling the compliance review meeting.

If anything is going to slip the date let me know now and we can push the review week by a few days.

—Sam
Dev Ops, ACME

[Attachment: iac-evidence.csv (text/csv, 34KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Dev Ops (ACME) <devops@acme.example.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, ACME Procurement <procure@acme.example.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Priv infra CI maintainability & handoff request

Sam — thanks, clear list. We can deliver by the date but will split artifacts into two batches: (1) evidence + module inventory and (2) CI diffs + runbook.

Ownership: Laura will own the artifact inventory + evidence CSV, Vivek will produce the CI diff and a short runbook for policy checks. I will coordinate and confirm hashes.

Action items (Redwood):
- Laura: module inventory + signed evidence CSV (target: Mon 9/15 12:00pm PDT)
- Vivek: CI pipeline diff + runbook (target: Mon 9/15 4:00pm PDT)
- Marissa: review hashes and deliver the combined bundle to your Drive link (by 9/15 6:00pm PDT)

Laura/Vivek — I added ACME procurement to keep their calendar open for a 30m review on Tue. If you need more time, flag now.

Thanks —
Marissa
Director, Customer Deployments
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Ops (ACME) <devops@acme.example.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 11:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Priv infra CI maintainability & handoff request

Adding the inventory checklist and quick notes from my side —

Checklist (inventory + evidence CSV):
- terraform/modules/*: list of modules, last-modifier, semantic version tag (if any)
- helm/charts/*: chart name, values override files used for private deploys
- ansible/roles/*: role name + required creds sources (vault/KMS)
- BOM column: binary artifact hashes (sha256), signed commit refs, and provenance link
- Evidence column: pointer to signed tag in git + CI job ID that produced artifact

Runbook notes for the CI checks (preview):
- Install pre-commit and policy-linting tools (link to script included)
- Command: ./scripts/policy-check.sh --local --fail-on=error (exit codes 0/1)
- Expected output: JSON summary at build/policy-summary.json with `policy_status: pass`

I attached the CI diff patch with only pipeline config changes (two new stages: policy-lint and artifact-sign). Vivek — pls confirm the paths and the helm values we want pinned for ACME.

[Attachment: ci-pipeline-diff.patch (text/plain, 4KB)]

—Laura
Engineering Manager, Private Deployments

From: Dev Ops (ACME) <devops@acme.example.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: ACME Procurement <procure@acme.example.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Sep 2025 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Priv infra CI maintainability & handoff request

Marissa/Laura/Vivek — this is perfect, thanks. A couple quick clarifications before the Tuesday review:

- For the evidence CSV, can you include the signing key fingerprint and indicate whether the key is customer-managed or Redwood-managed? Procurement needs that column.
- On the runbook, we want the exact docker image tag for the policy-checker so we can run it in our air-gapped environment. If you can list the image digest that would be ideal.

We’ll tentatively take the artifact bundle from your Drive link and schedule the procurement review for Tue 9/16 10:00am PDT (30m). Procurement (cc) will send a calendar invite.

If you prefer, we can accept incremental uploads — just note which files are final.

Thanks again —Sam
Dev Ops, ACME
